$comment: S20 USGS earthquakes (T072). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s20.yaml; rules: decision D110.

fields.name: event_id
fields.meaning: id, the preferred ComCat event ID

fields.name: magnitude
fields.meaning: properties.mag; null with missing_reason not_reported when not determined

fields.name: mag_type
fields.meaning: properties.magType, for example mb, mww, ml

fields.name: updated_at
fields.meaning: properties.updated; the version key with event_id

kept: type earthquake inside the requested box; deleted events and other types are dropped
redistribution: false until the USGS licence statement is recorded (D110)
